notes: POC objective: validate Redwood Private running inside Aurora's AWS VPC with customer-managed KMS and audit log forwarding to Splunk. Scope: deploy Redwood runtime via Helm into Aurora EKS cluster using our terraform module; verify model-serving end-to-end for clinical-document embeddings + patient-chat flow. Acceptance criteria (customer-facing): 1) No outbound internet from model workers; all control-plane endpoints via PrivateLink or customer NAT allowed per firewall rules. 2) KMS integration: CMK used for model artifact at rest and S3 backups; key policy must allow Redwood service principal + Aurora account. 3) Audit logs streaming into Splunk, retention policy set to 7 years per compliance. 4) Performance: chat p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token requests under test traffic (50 qps burst), embeddings throughput >= 1200 vectors/min for nightly batch. 5) Sign-off by Security + Platform (security OK, perf OK, cost estimate in range).
